name: Asahina Yua
source:
A schoolgirl in the cheerleading club.  She has a cheerful and caring personality and is adored by her friends and younger students. 

By chance, she is transported to another world, but fortunately, Chihiro picks her up.  For a while, she does menial work at a bar, but then decides to start prostituting herself.

At first, she is hesitant and afraid of the naughty acts, but she gradually becomes more active, partly because she is blessed with customers.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkmew/mew004/]official site[/url]]
